The [[Insectoid Scythe]] is a very large [[scythe]] that somewhat resembles the leg of an insect. A winged insect appears to be perched on top of the head.

==Acquisition==
;[[Eye of the North]]
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**[[Arachni's Haunt]]
***[[Arachni's Spoils]]

==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects the entire scythe, dyeing everything except the insect's wings to the color specified. The wings will dye to the inverse color of the dye. The default color can be closely replicated using yellow dye.
{{dye chart}}
